findings.text: follow-on: cohort_shots is a near byte-for-byte duplicate of benchmarks/mast_tf_average.py:109 (same ShotSurvey reconstruction, same calibration_experiments(TOROIDAL_FIELD_ONLY) filter, differing only in local spellings), and mast_tf_average.py was already present at the reviewed base commit. The two benchmarks now fork one capability the repository owns; consolidating the census-to-cohort adapter into one benchmark helper (or importing one from the other) would leave one owner.

follow-on: the added tests exercise only infer_orientation and score_observations. inventory(), cohort_shots() and the receipt they render are untested, so the node's actual delivered artifact - the receipt with its positive control - is unguarded: a regression that dropped the positive-control check or mislabelled the unresolved reason would leave all four tests green.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite field is empty, so the base arm is not readable from the record and the added-failure count is derived as unmeasured (null) rather than a measured zero; there is no pre-change arm because the focused test file is added by this node, so the base arm log on disk (revision 1d34f09) ran the new tests and is not a baseline.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against base 1d34f09cb6d4f14fdfbe6760f5a48ef3224b5903: 867869d adds the benchmark (268 lines) and test (58 lines), 3cd9ca5 refines control-channel matching in the benchmark (+11/-2), 5a0727c adds the receipt (366 lines); 701 insertions over three files, no product source or test-adjacent module changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: The receipt names the orientation and held-out agreement per probe, promotes only at the pre-registered 2% held-out relative tolerance, takes the toroidal-field-only cohort of nova/imas/mast_calibration_cohort.py as its shot source, and leaves mast_seed_parameters.py's magnetic probe parameters unchanged. I re-ran the named gate at reviewed head 5a0727c14e8858bb4f9c8b952d07cb897f1f1b05 in a scratch tree (4 passed, EXIT=0) and reproduced the declared negative control (comparator <= changed to >= gave 3 failed, EXIT=1). The data pass ran as one all_debug job (1282031, COMPLETED, exit 0:0), and I independently reproduced the headline: 577 TF-only shots, 0 of them with a level-2 zarr.
item_verdicts.goal: The node was dispatched to resolve the MAST toroidal-field probe orientation from coil-driven vacuum shots. It delivers benchmarks/mast_toroidal_probe_orientation.py, a signed-field inference gate plus an inventory, and docs/figures/mast-toroidal-probe-orientation/receipt.json reporting all 36 catalog toroidal probe positions resolved as `unresolved`, with a stated reason, because no toroidal-field-only vacuum shot carries a level-2 probe file and no independently sourced signed absolute TF reference exists. Faithful to the goal, which admits an unresolved verdict when held-out agreement is unavailable.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, three commits, gate 4 passed EXIT=0, a negative_control_log that fires, after_suite completed=true failure_count=0 at revision 5a0727c14e8858bb4f9c8b952d07cb897f1f1b05. Its baseline_suite field is empty, so the base arm is not readable from the manifest's declared fields.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the reviewed manifest's declared paths; git diff 1d34f09cb6d4f14fdfbe6760f5a48ef3224b5903..5a0727c14e8858bb4f9c8b952d07cb897f1f1b05 is exactly three added files, all inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_mast_toroidal_probe_orientation.py adds four assertions on infer_orientation and score_observations and the declared comparator mutation reddens three of them, so the inference and the promotion gate are guarded; not higher because inventory, cohort_shots and the receipt it renders - including the positive-control requirement that makes the zero-of-577 absence meaningful - have no test, so a regression there would stay green.
justifications.evidence: The named gate reproduces at the reviewed head (4 passed, EXIT=0) and the declared negative control fires with exactly the three added test ids, and the receipt's headline independently reproduces against the census and level-2 store (577 TF-only shots, 0 with level-2, control shot 30420 present outside the cohort); not 20 because the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite is empty so the base arm is unmeasured and the added-failure count is null.
justifications.fit: The module follows the benchmarks/ idiom (module docstring, argparse, main) set by benchmarks/mast_tf_average.py, uses dataclasses.fields as the repo prefers, and the commits carry two-part conventional messages; a label scan over the added lines finds no phase, stage, sprint, ticket or version identifier and no worktree path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The landed instrument and its docs/figures/mast-toroidal-probe-orientation/receipt.json answer the goal with a documented unresolved verdict on all 36 positions (0 of 577 TF-only shots carry a level-2 probe file), which the done_when explicitly admits; not 20 because the question terminates in a negative that transfers the decisive inference to a follow-on needing new data.
justifications.reuse: cohort_shots at benchmarks/mast_toroidal_probe_orientation.py:91 re-implements, with only identifier spelling changed, the existing cohort_shots at benchmarks/mast_tf_average.py:109, which was present at the reviewed base; the node's other definitions (infer_orientation, score_observations) have no prior owner, but one added definition duplicates repository code, which caps this dimension at 5.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1d34f09cb6d4f14fdfbe6760f5a48ef3224b5903 5a0727c14e8858bb4f9c8b952d07cb897f1f1b05 is exactly three added paths under the declared write paths; no product source, plan, sprint or index state touched, and no worktree path appears in any changed file.
